hero.title: The Farm That Built Its Own Operating System
hero.lead: 35 hectares. 3,500 trees. One custom-built Farm OS tracking every block, every harvest, every expense. This is not just a farm — this is where our technology meets the soil.
hero.introBody: Every tree is mapped. Every block is tracked. Every expense is logged. Our farm runs on the same operating system we built for traceability — not paper, not spreadsheets, not guesswork.

overview.heading: 35 Hectares. One System. Complete Visibility.
overview.description: Our family-owned plantation in Odienné is managed through Farm OS — a custom platform that tracks every block by GPS coordinates, survival rate, planting date, and harvest history. What happens on this farm doesn't stay in a paper ledger. It flows into dashboards that buyers and investors can see.

processing.title: Future Processing
processing.description: On-site facility planned for 2031 — designed to integrate directly with Farm OS for end-to-end traceability.

harvest.title: First Harvest
harvest.description: First commercial harvest projected for 2028. Every kilogram will be logged by block, date, and quality grade in Farm OS.

land.title: Land Development
land.description: Soil mapping, land clearing, and irrigation — every activity documented with photos and GPS data in Farm OS.

planting.title: Planting Operations
planting.description: 3,500 trees planted across 35 blocks. Each tree assigned to a block. Each block tracked for survival rate, growth stage, and maintenance.

harvest.title: First Commercial Harvest
harvest.description: Initial yield tracked per block. Quality metrics recorded. The data foundation for our processing center begins here.

sustainability.title: Sustainability You Can Verify
sustainability.description: Our Farm OS doesn't just track production. It tracks our environmental footprint: water usage, organic inputs, and soil health per block. Sustainability claims are easy. Data-backed sustainability is rare.

organic.title: Organic Cultivation
organic.description: Every input logged. Every application recorded per block, per date. Audit-ready for ECOCERT certification.

water.title: Water Stewardship
water.description: Drip irrigation reducing water usage by 40%. Consumption tracked monthly in Farm OS for continuous improvement.

community.title: Community Empowerment
community.description: 200+ farmers in our cooperative. Training programs tracked. Fair pricing documented. Impact measured, not just claimed.

hectares.label: Hectares Under Cultivation
hectares.description: 35 hectares tracked block-by-block in Farm OS — every tree, every input, every output recorded.

jobs.label: Jobs Created
jobs.description: Employment data tracked. Fair wage compliance monitored. Not estimates — actual payroll data.

farmers.label: Farmer Income
farmers.description: Cooperative pricing and volume tracked. Farmer payments documented. Transparent for investors and partners.

profits.label: Community Reinvestment
profits.description: 10% of profits reinvested. Projects tracked with budgets and completion status in Farm OS.

cta.title: See the System Behind the Farm
cta.description: Whether you're a wholesale buyer, investor, or distribution partner — we can show you the data, not just tell you the story.

map.title: Our Farm — GPS Mapped
map.description: Explore our 35-hectare farm in Odienné. Every block is GPS-mapped in Farm OS with planting dates, survival rates, and harvest history. Click any block to see its data.
map.locationDescription: GPS-verified coordinates. Not a claimed location — a verifiable one.
